title: NUT, HEX REGULAR, STEEL, SELF-LOCKING, CADMIUM PLATED BOA Item 7025AH
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE NAVY.NAVSEA.NAVSEA SHIPYARD.PORTSMOUTH NAVAL SHIPYARD GF
detail_text: This is a Pre-Solicitation notice for non-commercial products under Simplified Acquisition Procedures prepared in accordance with the format in FAR Subpart 13.105, as supplemented with additional information included in this notice. This announcement does not constitute a solicitation. A written/paper solicitation will be posted on sam.gov. The associated Request for Quotation (RFQ) number is N0010426RX19780 . The solicitation will document and incorporate provisions and clauses in effect through FAC 2025-06 and DFARS Change 2025 1110. It is the responsibility of the contractor to be familiar with the applicable clauses and provisions. The clauses may be accessed in full text at these addresses: https://www.acquisition.gov/ The NAICS code is 332722 and the Small Business Standard is 600 employees. This will be a 100% Small Business Set-Aside solicitation. The Portsmouth Naval Shipyard will seek responses from sources capable of providing the following: ITEM DESCRIPTION QTY 0001 NUT, HEX, HEAVY, GRADE 4 STEEL, PHOSPHATE COATED in accordance with the specifications listed in the Portsmouth Naval Shipyard C. R. Gilbert / E. F. Dickson Fastener Program manual. BOA Item: 7025AH NSN: 1H 5310 01-212-5696 X2 Nominal Size: 0.750" - 10UNC - 3B 780 Each 0002 Contract Data Requirements List for Item 0001 in full accordance with the Contract Data Requirements List for BOA Item 7025AH listed in the Portsmouth Naval Shipyard C. R. Gilbert / E. F. Dickson Fastener Program manual. 1 Set ***All manufacturing and data requirements shall be in full accordance with all of the specifications and Data requirements for BOA Item 7025AH listed in the Portsmouth Naval Shipyard C. R. Gilbert / E. F. Dickson Fastener Program manual. Requests for copies of the Portsmouth Naval Shipyard C. R. Gilbert / E. F. Dickson Fastener Program Manual, which contains necessary specifications and data requirements, can be made to (insert Contract Specialist and Contracting Officer). They can be contacted via email at ina.nason.civ@us.navy.mil. Please include the following with your request: • An active DD2345 form See below for submission instructions, evaluation criteria, and additional provisions and clauses applicable to this procurement. This procurement will be solicited under the Portsmouth Naval Shipyard C. R. Gilbert / E. F. Dickson Fastener Program. Information regarding this program is available upon request. Technical Confidence Submission: Vendors must possess a 2021 Portsmouth Naval Shipyard C. R. Gilbert / E. F. Dickson Fastener Program Manual and either: Hold a Basic Ordering Agreement that satisfies applicable procedure requirements for the item being ordered and Higher Level Contracting Quality Requirements of (1) MIL-I-45208 or (2) ISO 9001/9002 with STR-ISO 9000 Supplement A, or B, or C; or Provide the following: Applicable Non-Destructive Testing and/or Coating procedures (only if/when required by the technical data for individual fasteners); and Provide evidence of compliance with the Higher Level Contracting Quality Requirements of (1) MIL-I-45208 or (2) ISO 9001/9002 with STR-ISO 9000 Supplement A, or B, or C. If you are unable to meet the bidding requirements or do not receive an award for this action, you must submit a written confirmation to the Contracting Officer stating that the 2021 Portsmouth Naval Shipyard C. R. Gilbert / E. F. Dickson Fastener Program Manual has either been returned to the Portsmouth Naval Shipyard or destroyed as per the instructions provided in the DD2345 form. This confirmation should be submitted within 45 days following the closure date of this solicitation. • Delivery Point: Portsmouth Naval Shipyard, Kittery, ME. There will be no Government-Furnished Material. Contact Buyer who can be reached by email ina.nason.civ@us.navy.mil. This announcement will be publicized for 15 days, from 11, March 2026 ******* END OF SYNOPSIS ********
